Nora (partnerships): Heads-up: GCP aggregator rejected our PO batch for ResellerOne citing signature_scheme_mismatch. Customer is blocked from provisioning. :cry:
Evan (marketplace-ops): Can you paste the portal error and a sample header?
Nora (partnerships): Portal error: `{"code":"PO_VALIDATION","reason":"signature_scheme_mismatch"}`
Nora (partnerships): Sample PO header: `<PO id="R1-555"><Vendor>RESELLERONE</Vendor><SignatureScheme>PKCS7</SignatureScheme><Signatures><Sig>buyer</Sig><Sig>reseller</Sig></Signatures></PO>`
Ruth (finance): If signature scheme differs from expected (they want detached XML signature) we need to ensure the marketplace can accept PKCS7 blobs. That usually changes verification flow; check fraud team.
Sunil (eng-integrations): Tech note: our adapter currently emits `SignatureScheme=PKCS7` for legacy resellers. Marketplace expects `SignatureScheme=XMLDSIG`. We could add a middleware to transcode or wrap PKCS7 into an XMLDSIG envelope, but that's non-trivial for crypto validation. ETA ~5 days.
Diego (legal): Any change to signature format needs signatory consent if it affects legal acceptance of the PO. For a fast path we can request a one-off portal admin to accept the PKCS7 payload as-is and log an acknowledgement from buyer/reseller.
Tessa (customer-success): ResellerOne says they already signed the MSA and procurement team can sign an email confirmation if that helps. They need provisioning before EOD tomorrow.
MarketplaceBot: "Ticket MG-20451 created: PO batch rejected signature_scheme_mismatch. Partner review SLA 48h"
Evan (marketplace-ops): Two options: 1) Ask GCP partner admin for manual acceptance for these POs (fast if partner rep available) 2) Build a translation layer to convert PKCS7->XMLDSIG and store originals in audit log (safer long-term). Which path?
Nora (partnerships): Short-term manual approval + parallel engineering work sounds right. Can we get legal to prepare a waiver template?
Diego (legal): I'll draft a waiver email template that records buyer+reseller confirmation and indemnity language. Also require us to keep original signed artifacts untouched and available.
Ruth (finance): Accounting note: ensure invoice payee/billingEntity is unchanged by any transformation. If signature scheme maps to billing entity in partner mapping table, we cannot auto-convert. I'll run a quick lookup.
Sunil (eng-integrations): I'll prototype a converter as a separate container that reads PKCS7 payload and emits XMLDSIG-wrapped PO while preserving the original file S3://po-audit/resellerone/R1-555-original.p7b. If legal+finance greenlight, ETA 4 business days for safe rollout.
Tessa (customer-success): I'll get ResellerOne to send a short email confirming they accept the portal exception and will not retry the upload.
Evan (marketplace-ops): Opening escalation MG-20451-ESCALATED and pinging partner admin. MarketplaceBot: "MG-20451 status: escalated -> partner review requested. Update in ~6h."
Nora (partnerships): Action items: Tessa -> secure reseller email confirmation; Evan -> escalate with partner admin; Diego -> waiver template; Sunil -> prototype converter + audit plan; Ruth -> billingEntity check. We'll reconvene when partner responds or in 6 hours. :white_check_mark:
